d:
Hello.

Been a while. Big thanks to Kuroinu Juu for his amazing work and to 网上打飞机 for the scans. This is one of my favorite books from the author, it's kind of intense from beginning to end. When I fist looked at the cover I thought he would have a serious go at shibari, but the rope stopped being part of the plot after the race. Well... next time, I guess.

For the title 媚速前進, my best interpretation would be "Flirtatious rush/speed race", though at some point I wanted to use Debauchery or Temptation instead of Flirtatious.

Once again, translated an decensored by me. I apologize in advance for any mistakes in the translation.

Have fun.
n: [Doujinshi] [BLACK DOG (Kuroinu Juu)] Flirtatious rush race (Bishoujo Senshi Sailor Moon) [Digital] [Decensored] [English]
